{{Navbar-GOGPT-tracker}}
'''Chachoengsao NNK cogeneration power station''' is an operating power station of at least 110-megawatts (MW) in Khlong Nakhon Nueang Khet, Chachoengsao, Thailand.
It is also known as GNNK.
